description.value:
The storm you channel grows mightier. Your Raging Elements options gain the following effects.

Icefury. Whether or not you hit, the target subtracts half the total rolled (round down) from the next damage roll it makes before the start of your next turn.

Lava Burst. Whether or not the target fails its save, it and each enemy within 10 feet of it start burning.

Lightning Bolt. Whether or not the target fails its save, a bolt leaps from it to another target of your choice you can see within 30 feet of the first. The new target makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking Lightning damage equal to the total on a failure or half as much on a success.
